title: Command ownership check misses colliding handlers after separate-value global flags
body:
## Summary

The new catalog runner can approve `pm-presets` ownership while the pinned CLI executes a different package's `presets list` handler. Separate-value global options cause the ownership check and real dispatch to resolve different command paths.

## Exact scope and provenance

- Source tested: `unbraind/pm-web@f5b90ac7bc8a8cf895af754a6fbfdb235dd438d7`, package version `2026.10.11`.
- Actual installed dispatcher: official `@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.10`, matching Web's exact dependency; Node `24.19.0`.
- [Affected ownership helper](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f5b90ac7bc8a8cf895af754a6fbfdb235dd438d7/src/services/pm-runner.ts#L1057-L1091) and [route](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f5b90ac7bc8a8cf895af754a6fbfdb235dd438d7/src/routes/extensions.ts#L254-L289).
- Introduced by merged [#175](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/pull/175); related completed PM owner [pm-web-s99c](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f5b90ac7bc8a8cf895af754a6fbfdb235dd438d7/.agents/pm/issues/pm-web-s99c.toon).
- This is a **current-main/source finding**. Registry `@unbrained/pm-web@2026.10.11` identifies `ff02cf5de9ce2ec13ea0d30d6114450560cd1861`, before #175. No deployed or published-package exposure is asserted.

## Sanitized reproduction

Use a disposable initialized tracker and script-disabled official CLI install. Install and activate two entirely synthetic extensions:

1. `pm-presets`, priority 1, registers command `presets`, returning `{ok:true,owner:"pm-presets"}`.
2. `scratch-shadow`, priority 1000, registers `presets list`, returning `{ok:true,owner:"scratch-shadow"}`.

Each extension uses a normal manifest with `manifest_version:1`, `entry:"./index.ts"`, `capabilities:["commands"]`, and `activate(api) { api.registerCommand({name,description:"synthetic",run(){return result}}) }`. Run `package install <synthetic-path> --project --json`, then `package activate <name> --project --json`.

Obtain the actual `package describe --project --json` receipt. Execute the **unchanged** source `commandOwnershipError` with that receipt returned by its `runProcess` dependency and expected `{command:"presets",name:"pm-presets",args}`. Only the process transport is replaced; ownership rows come from real installed CLI execution. Compare with real CLI dispatch:

| Supplied args after presets | Ownership helper | Actual CLI owner |
|---|---|---|
| `list --json` | Refuses scratch-shadow | scratch-shadow |
| `--author synthetic list --json` | **null: allowed** | **scratch-shadow** |
| `--output-format json list --json` | **null: allowed** | **scratch-shadow** |
| `--author=synthetic list --json` | Refuses scratch-shadow | Not needed for the failing-case proof |

Example passing-through route input: `{"command":"pm presets","args":["--author","synthetic","list","--json"]}`.

The exact extracted TypeScript helper SHA-256 was `ae77965435324d7bf16273f86d580a193c75f3c747927f1bc3dbe19bdeb6668c`.

## Expected and actual

Expected: owner validation resolves the same effective command as the pinned dispatcher and refuses the conflicting `presets list` winner.

Actual: the helper skips tokens starting with `-` but appends their values to the positional path. It therefore checks `presets synthetic list` or `presets json list`, never the actual `presets list` row, then returns null. The CLI consumes recognized global option values and selects the shadow handler.

## Impact and limits

A project editor selecting a catalog package can execute another enabled package's colliding handler, breaking the new owner-binding contract. This does not establish privilege escalation or cross-project access.

This is a fresh exact-source-helper reproduction plus real pinned-CLI dispatch in synthetic workspaces. The complete Web HTTP/PostgreSQL suite and hosted deployment were **not** run. The existing [source/built collision acceptance](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-web/blob/f5b90ac7bc8a8cf895af754a6fbfdb235dd438d7/test/catalog-install-e2e.test.ts) covers plain positional extension but not separate-value global options.

## Acceptance criteria

- Normalize argv using the same command resolver/flag arity contract as the pinned CLI, preferably a reusable public SDK contract; fail closed when exact resolution is unavailable.
- Extend real source and built HTTP collision acceptance with both separate-value reproductions. Require HTTP 409, no shadow execution marker, and unchanged settings.
- Cover equivalent equals forms, flags before/after nested subcommands, boolean flags and terminators; preserve successful commands actually owned by the selected package.
- Keep existing full release/coverage gates and report their exact tested source and publication boundary.

All-state issue/PR review and canonical owner checks found no separate existing follow-up for this flag-value divergence. This issue follows the completed #175 scope rather than duplicating the fleet-catalog feature.
